start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:keep-operation-work-records with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_shop on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-shop-postgres-connection\"} and operations [{\"op\": \"write\", \"address\": \"operation-records.work-fact:w9\", \"value\": {\"state\": \"open\"}, \"expected_version\": null}]."
no_lists_because: It names no list: the work records are kept in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps things, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the store is and how it is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:keep-operation-work-records" with store and the operations to run. Read a record first, then write it on the version you read.
3. The first run makes the store's own objects once and proves them on the example attempts: every answer must be the one the intent says, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run makes its writes and batches through those objects; a conflict means another AI wrote first, so read again before deciding.
